name: Minazuki Mizuki
source:
Shizuka, a classmate of protagonist Tokusa Amehiko. She excels academically, has a kind personality, and is a natural leader in the class. 

She is Kagazume's biological daughter, though she herself is unaware of this fact. 

Due to Shizuka's jealousy of her parent-child relationship with Kagazume, she ends up being raped by Shizuka and Amehiko.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=23975&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
